title: Measure ecommerce (Google Analytics 4)
supports: Fetched. Ecommerce event order from view_item_list to purchase and refund; items array up to 200 elements; up to 27 custom item parameters; refund needs transaction_id, with item details recommended for item-level refund metrics. No updated date shown.

title: Recommended events (GA4 events reference)
supports: Fetched. Purchase parameters: transaction_id and items required; value and currency (currency required when value is set); value is the sum of price times quantity, without shipping or tax.

title: [GA4] Ecommerce purchases report
supports: Fetched. Item revenue excludes tax and shipping; ecommerce events are not collected automatically; events missing required parameters become custom events; a Shopify store with Google Analytics set up collects add_to_cart, begin_checkout and purchase; some metrics only from 8 September 2022.

title: [GA4] Cohort exploration
supports: Fetched. Inclusion and return criteria; weekly cohorts run Sunday to Saturday; standard, rolling and cumulative calculations; up to 60 cohorts; breakdowns show the top 15 values; based on device data only, User-ID not considered.

title: [GA4] Data retention
supports: Fetched. Standard properties keep user- and event-level data for 2 or 14 months; the setting affects explorations and funnel reports only, not standard reports; Large and XL properties limited to 2 months.

title: [GA4] BigQuery Export
supports: Fetched. Standard properties: daily export limit of 1 million events; streaming export is best-effort; daily tables can be updated for up to two days and when Google reprocesses data; sandbox and charges.

title: [GA4] Data thresholds
supports: Fetched. System-defined thresholds withhold data to stop identification of individuals, for example with demographics or search queries; they cannot be adjusted; a wider date range can help.

title: [GA4] Get started with attribution
supports: Fetched. Current models ("data-driven attribution", paid and organic last click, Google paid channels last click); first click, linear, time decay and position-based removed November 2023; direct visits get no credit unless the whole path is direct; DDA credit can change for up to 7 days.

title: Consent mode overview
supports: Fetched. Four consent types; basic mode blocks tags until consent; advanced mode sends cookieless pings while consent is denied, which allows more detailed modelling; what each denied type still sends.

title: [GA4] Behavioral modeling for consent mode
supports: Fetched. Eligibility: at least 1,000 events a day with analytics_storage denied for at least 7 days, and at least 1,000 daily users with it granted on at least 7 of the previous 28 days; not modelled: audiences, user explorer, cohort and user lifetime explorations, retention reports, predictive metrics and BigQuery export; Blended reporting identity needed.

title: Google Analytics MCP server (GitHub repository)
supports: Fetched. Report, funnel, realtime and admin tools; read-only by default; write tools (annotations, custom dimensions, key events) only with --allow-write and the analytics.edit scope.

title: Customer reports (cohort analysis, RFM, predicted spend tier)
supports: Fetched. Cohorts grouped by first order date, by week, month or quarter; metrics; projections need 24 months of data; RFM scores 1 to 5 relative to the store (5 = top 20%), FM = (F + M) / 2 rounded down, 11 groups; customer reports use each customer's whole order history.

title: Behaviour reports (conversion funnel)
supports: Fetched. Funnel steps (cart additions, reached checkout, completed checkout); open and closed funnels; session measurement rollout 21 to 23 September 2026 may change session metrics; session history starts 1 October 2022; bot filter.

title: Finances report definitions
supports: Fetched. Gross sales, discounts, returns, net sales, shipping, taxes and total sales; returns recorded as negatives on the date processed; only net sales with cost recorded count toward gross profit.

title: Marketing reports and attribution
supports: Fetched. Last non-direct click, last click, first click, any click (can exceed real orders) and linear; sessions end after 30 minutes; first-interaction referrer resets after 30 days; September 2026 change to include all traffic; 18 October 2026 referring channel value changes; sales show goods value, include canceled, pending and unpaid orders, exclude chargebacks.

title: Analytics discrepancies
supports: Fetched. Why Shopify and Google Analytics differ: reloads, bots, JavaScript and cookies, browser extensions, time zones and tracking methods; session measurement update in September 2026.

title: Customer privacy settings (cookie banner)
supports: Fetched. Banner regions (EEA and UK as examples) collect non-essential data only after consent, lowering session counts and conversion rates; banner off by default in regions like the US; Global Privacy Control opt-outs flagged.

title: Pixels (customer events)
supports: Fetched. App and custom pixels run in a sandbox and load on storefront, checkout, thank you and order status pages; in consent-required markets such as the EEA and UK they run only after visitors grant permission.

title: Authorizing access for AI tools
supports: Fetched. Official connectors for named AI tools; read-only or write access approved in the Shopify admin; access can be raised but not lowered without reinstalling; limited by the staff member's permissions.

title: Google Analytics 4 (set up on Shopify)
supports: Fetched. GA4 is connected through the Google & YouTube app and Google's tag set-up; Universal Analytics stopped processing new data on 1 July 2023.

title: "Counting Your Customers" the Easy Way: An Alternative to the Pareto/NBD Model (Fader, Hardie and Lee, Marketing Science, 2005)
supports: Fetched. Paper details and abstract: BG/NBD model for predicting repeat purchasing from recency and frequency, simpler to fit than Pareto/NBD, including in a spreadsheet.

title: 2024 Consumer Returns in the Retail Industry
publisher: National Retail Federation and Happy Returns
supports: Fetched. Total returns projected at $890 billion in 2024; 93% of retailers surveyed call return fraud and abuse a significant issue; published 5 December 2024. Sample size not stated on the page.

title: Cart abandonment rate statistics
supports: Fetched. 70.22% average of 50 studies (2006 to 2025); US checkout abandonment reasons: extra costs 40%, slow delivery 20%, distrust with card details 19%; updated 28 October 2026.

title: Data protection and online privacy (cookies)
supports: Fetched. Sites must get consent before setting cookies, except those needed to transmit a communication or strictly needed for a service the user asked for; consent must be an opt-in.

title: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025: data protection and privacy changes
publisher: GOV.UK (Department for Science, Innovation and Technology)
supports: Fetched. The Act allows some low-risk storage and access technologies without consent; changes commence in stages 2 to 12 months after Royal Assent on 19 June 2025; refers to the ICO for guidance.

title: Private Browsing 2.0
supports: Fetched (post dated 16 July 2024). Link Tracking Protection removes click-level tracking parameters in Private Browsing while campaign attribution parameters pass; available in all browsing if the user turns on advanced protection.

title: Guarantees and returns (right of withdrawal)
supports: Fetched (last checked 28/04/2026). 14-day right to cancel online purchases, running from delivery for goods; listed exceptions.

title: Accepting returns and giving refunds
supports: Fetched. UK online buyers have 14 days from receipt to cancel and another 14 days to return; refunds due within 14 days of receiving the returned item.
